verdict.rationale: Chronicle documents querying telemetry events through its SDK and a REST endpoint (POST /v1/search, semantic search over event content), so an agent could programmatically pull traces to debug. Nothing shows a first-party MCP server for querying this data, or API access to metrics or eval/score results. The MCP servers mentioned are simulated environment components, not a query interface. missing for 10: an official MCP server for querying observability data, documented API access to eval results and metrics, a published OpenAPI spec (probe returned 404), and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can have an agent query my traces, metrics, and eval results through an API or MCP server to debug my app

citations.quote: then query them in Timeline or through the SDK
